lane: fault-zone anatomy (secondary strands around mapped faults)
retention_rule: candidate retained only if its paired 95% CI lower bound against the reference arm under the same flank policy is strictly positive; otherwise the simpler arm ships
budget_rule: per-quadrant cap times the TRAINING fraction of withheld positives inside the fitted zone, clipped to [0.25, 1.0]; k_truth comes from the TRAINING base rate times allowed cells, never from test truth
width_law: W(L)=w0*(L/L0)**gamma fitted on training folds only by bin-wise quantile regression of withheld distance on mapped-component length, bin bootstrap CI
